[[File:Dinner_at_Varykino.png|thumb|right|250px|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] in the Room of Morning Mists.]]
The '''Room of Morning Mists''' was a rotunda in the [[Varykino/Legends|Varykino]] retreat in the [[Lake Country/Legends|Lake Country]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. It was used as a dining area while the lake retreat was under the ownership of the [[Naberrie family/Legends|Naberrie family]].

The controversial [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] poet [[Omar Berenko/Legends|Omar Berenko]] wrote some of his most famous works in this room, while staying at Varykino centuries prior to the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]]. The visionary epic poem, [[Defense of Naboo/Legends|''Defense of Naboo'']], was believed to have been written here.

While staying at Varykino following two assassination attempts on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] shared dinner in the Room of Morning Mists. They were waited on by [[Nandi]] and [[Teckla Minnau/Legends|Teckla]], and Anakin displayed his [[The Force/Legends|Force powers]] by using it to casually float a piece of [[Shuura/Legends|shuura]] fruit across the table to Padmé.
